body_markdown:
Origin Bank today announced Austin Lewis has been promoted to the role of North Texas regional president. For the past 16 years, Lewis has dedicated his time at Origin to building relationships and serving customers. He has specialized in commercial and private banking strategies for middle-market operating companies and high-net-worth individuals, as well as local and national real estate companies.


“Austin’s story is a great example of what Origin’s culture is all about,” said Drake Mills, chairman, president and CEO of Origin Bancorp, Inc. “He started with us as a retail banker and has advanced his career through hard work, integrity and a deep commitment to our customers. I have full confidence in Austin to build on the foundation we’ve established in North Texas and to lead our team to continued success.”


In his new position, Lewis will oversee Origin’s North Texas region, including its commercial, private banking, retail and treasury management teams. He will be responsible for the region’s performance, banking centers, strategic growth initiatives, talent development, credit discipline and client outcomes, while cultivating an exceptional experience for the bank’s customers and employees.


“North Texas is one of the most dynamic growth markets in the country, and our team has built strong momentum here since entering Dallas in 2008,” said Lance Hall, president and CEO of Origin Bank. “I’ve had the privilege of watching Austin grow as a banker and as a leader, and I’m excited for him to step into this role and lead the region in a way that creates lasting value for our employees, customers, communities and shareholders.”


Lewis joined Origin in 2010 as a retail relationship banker and has since held roles in commercial portfolio management and commercial lending, most recently as executive vice president and commercial group manager. Throughout his career, he has focused on driving strategic growth, building and mentoring high-performing teams, maintaining strong credit discipline and strengthening client relationships through comprehensive, multi-product financial solutions.


“I’m honored and grateful for the opportunity to lead a team I’ve worked alongside since I began my career at Origin,” said Lewis. “I’ve seen firsthand what’s possible when people are empowered to grow, and I want to create that same opportunity for the talented bankers on our team. When we invest in our people, they take great care of our customers, and that’s how we’ll continue to succeed in North Texas.”


Lewis earned a bachelor’s degree in finance from Louisiana State University and is a graduate of the Southwestern Graduate School of Banking at SMU. He is actively involved in the Dallas community, serving on the boards of Family Gateway and Community Partners of Dallas, as well as on the Treasure Street board for Scottish Rite for Children. He and his wife, Mackenzie, a Dallas native, have three sons. Lewis maintains an office at Origin’s Dallas Financial Center, located at 3838 Oak Lawn Avenue in Dallas.


**About Origin**


Origin Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Ruston, Louisiana. Origin’s wholly owned bank subsidiary, Origin Bank, was founded in 1912 in Choudrant, Louisiana. Deeply rooted in Origin’s history is a culture committed to providing personalized relationship banking to businesses, municipalities, and personal clients to enrich the lives of the people in the communities it serves. Origin provides a broad range of financial services and currently operates more than 57 locations in Dallas/Fort Worth, East Texas, Houston, North Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and the Florida Panhandle. For more information, visit www.origin.bank. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender.
